The '''weapon integration and targeting system''', also known as '''WITS''', was an inbuilt system included in [[GTU]]'s [[AV-1C Combat Armor]] and [[AV-1A Assault Armor]]. It allowed the suit's wearer to link two weapon into the suit's internal [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
